item.title: OfiLibre receives LUT University
item.description: This Tuesday, May 6, 2025, we had the pleasure of receiving Victoria Kompanets, Funding Advisor, Research Services at LUT University (Finland), member of EULiST, at our office.

item.title: We're starting the course with scholarship holders!
item.description: From its origins, OfiLibre has committed to playing a significant formative role, offering Training Scholarships to open its doors to students interested in free culture.

item.title: Happy 2024
item.description: Dear university community: From OfiLibre, part of the Vice-Rectorate for Community, Campus, Culture and Sports, we want to wish you a 2024 full of open materials, many open publications, using free software and reusing open data.

item.title: Transformative agreement with publisher Wiley for open access publishing
item.description: According to the Vicerrectorado de Extensión Universitaria, the URJC has signed a new agreement with the publisher Wiley, which will allow authors from the URJC to read and publish open access articles.

item.title: Beca de Software Libre de OfiLibre
item.description: At the beginning of December, the ordinary call for 2021 was published on the university’s electronic bulletin board, offering 74 Collaboration Grants cofinanced with Banco Santander, for training in different services of the Rey Juan Carlos University, in favor of students enrolled at the URJC.
